name: 3D Perlin Noise
aliases: Simplex Noise (incorrectly named in some contexts, but this is standard Perlin)
definition: Generates a continuous scalar value for 3D space using gradient vectors at lattice points, interpolated via cubic smoothing functions.
summary: 3D Perlin Noise generates continuous scalar fields by interpolating gradient vectors, distinguished by its fifth-order fade function and coordinate wrapping to eliminate grid artifacts.
